message.content:
Here’s a classic set of ingredients you’ll find on most lasagna recipes—feel free to tweak them based on your taste or dietary preferences: | Category | Typical Ingredients | |----------|---------------------| | **Pasta** | • Lasagna sheets (regular or “no‑boil” type)
• Optional: fresh egg‑based sheets if you’re making from scratch | | **Meat & Protein** | • Ground beef (or mix of pork + veal)
• Ricotta cheese
• Egg (helps bind ricotta) | | **Sauce Base** | • Tomato paste or crushed tomatoes
• Onion (finely chopped)
• Garlic cloves (minced)
• Olive oil (for sautéing onion/garlic) | | **Seasoning / Herbs** | • Salt & black pepper
• Dried oregano
• Basil (fresh or dried)
• Red pepper flakes (optional for heat) | | **Cheeses** | • Shredded mozzarella (mozzarella di bufala works great too)
• Grated Parmesan (or Pecorino Romano) | | **Optional Extras** | • Fresh spinach or kale (sautéed until wilted)
• Mushrooms (sliced)
• Bell peppers (diced)
• Carrots (grated)
• Zucchini (thinly sliced) | ### Quick Ingredient Checklist 1. **Lasagna sheets** – 9–12 pieces depending on dish size 2. **Ground meat** – ½ lb per person (adjust for vegans → use lentils or tofu) 3. **Ricotta** – ¾ cup per layer (about 1 cup total) 4. **Mozzarella** – 2 cups shredded (plus extra for topping) 5. **Parmesan** – ¼ cup grated (mix into ricotta or sprinkle on top) 6. **Tomato sauce** – 2–3 cups (homemade or jarred) 7. **Onion & garlic** – 1 small onion + 2–3 cloves garlic 8. **Olive oil** – 1 tbsp for sautéing 9. **Egg** – 1 beaten (in ricotta mixture) 10. **Herbs & spices** – Oregano, basil, salt, pepper, red pepper flakes Feel free to swap out meats, add vegetables, or experiment with different cheeses—you’ve got plenty of room to make it uniquely yours!
message.reasoning:
The user asks about ingredients for lasagna. This is not a request for flight schedule; it's general cooking knowledge. We can answer directly without calling tool.

We should provide typical list of ingredients: pasta sheets or no-boil noodles, ground beef, onions, garlic, tomato sauce, ricotta cheese, mozzarella, parmesan, eggs, salt, pepper, herbs (oregano, basil), optional spinach, etc. Provide variations maybe vegetarian with veggies. Also mention layering instructions perhaps but question only asked ingredients. So just give ingredient list.

No need to call function.
